title: Optimal Location Of Aerial Firefighting Resources To Maximize Coverage: A Case Study Of Greece
affiliations: University of Western Macedonia and

detail.title: Optimal Location Of Aerial Firefighting Resources To Maximize Coverage: A Case Study Of Greece
detail.abstract: Wildfires affect many different regions of the world having many negative consequences on humans, wildlife, and the economy. Aerial resources play a crucial role in combating wildfires and an effective resource location plan is of paramount importance for enhancing their utilization. To this effect, several factors should be considered such as the fire hazard levels of each area, the specificities of the aerial firefighting fleet, the availability of airbases (airports and heliports), etc. In the present study, a decision support model is developed, under realistic assumptions and driven by practical considerations, to dictate the optimal assignment of aerial firefighting resources to the available facilities, in order to maximize the expected coverage. To demonstrate the applicability of the model, Greece is employed as a case study, considering multi-year wildfire statistics, the Greek aerial firefighting fleet, and the licensed airbases in Greek territory. Finally, the effectiveness of the model is evaluated through a comparison between the optimal solution and an existing location plan of Greek aerial firefighting resources.

title: Sustainable Manufacturing: Multi-Objective Optimization of Production and Environmental Impact

detail.title: Sustainable Manufacturing: Multi-Objective Optimization of Production and Environmental Impact
detail.abstract: This study examines sustainable manufacturing through the lens of multi-objective optimization, focusing on the simultaneous improvement of production efficiency and reduction of environmental impact in industrial systems. Drawing on prior empirical studies, optimization frameworks, and applied industrial analytics, the research synthesizes evidence on how multi-objective decision models outperform single-objective production strategies in balancing economic and environmental goals (Adeparusi and Ajenifuja; Chen et al.; Khan and Gupta). The findings indicate that multi-objective optimization approaches consistently reduce carbon emissions, energy intensity, and environmental risk while maintaining stable or improved production outputs (Orion and Imogen; Kumar and Kumar). However, the results also reveal trade-offs, including short-term cost increases and operational complexity when environmental constraints are tightened (AdeparuBhalani). The study concludes that sustainable manufacturing cannot be achieved through isolated efficiency optimization alone and that multi-objective frameworks aligned with Industry 5.0 principles offer a more resilient and responsible pathway for industrial development (Chen et al.; Ajenifuja and Adeparusi 2024b).

title: Autonomous Analytical Coherence (AAC): A Governance Framework for Mitigating Agentic Divergence in Decentralized Enterprise Data Meshes
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Autonomous Analytical Coherence (AAC): A Governance Framework for Mitigating Agentic Divergence in Decentralized Enterprise Data Meshes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Since your research is based on simulated data (50,000 finance transactions and 30,000 logistics events) rather than live human participants or patients, formal ethics approval is not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.

keywords: Enterprise Analytics & Process Intelligence Affiliation: Independent Research Contribution Agentic Data Mesh

detail.abstract: Enterprises are rapidly shifting from human-interpreted dashboards to Autonomous Analytical Entities (AAE) that execute decisions directly on production systems. This transition introduces a new failure mode-Agentic Divergence-where decentralized agents act on misaligned, drifted, or out-of-scope data products and metadata, leading to highimpact errors at scale. This paper proposes the Autonomous Analytical Coherence (AAC) framework, centered on an Analytical Control Plane (ACP) that inserts a mandatory, machine-enforced governance layer between AAEs and decentralized data products. The ACP mandates Agentic Data Contracts (ADC) as runtime dependencies and enforces Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence-based drift checks within Trusted Execution Environments (TEE) to safeguard both analytical coherence and data sovereignty. Simulation-based experiments across finance and logistics workloads indicate that AAC reduces erroneous autonomous transactions by 77% compared with uncoordinated agent deployments, with only a 25 ms median increase in latency. These results demonstrate that treating governance as a runtime dependency is a practical path toward safe, high-stakes autonomous analytics in enterprise data meshes.

AI.tldr: 企业从人工解读仪表板转向自主分析实体（AAE）时，面临代理分歧风险——去中心化代理基于不匹配、漂移或超出范围的数据产品和元数据做出决策，导致大规模高影响错误。本文提出自主分析一致性（AAC）框架，通过分析控制平面（ACP）在AAE和去中心化数据产品之间插入强制性的机器执行治理层，使用基于KL散度的漂移检查和可信执行环境来保障分析一致性和数据主权。
AI.research_question: 如何解决企业从人工仪表板转向自主分析实体（AAE）时出现的代理分歧问题，确保去中心化代理在数据网格中安全、一致地执行决策？
AI.motivation: 企业正快速从人工解读仪表板转向自主分析实体（AAE），这些实体直接在生产系统上执行决策。这种转变引入了新的故障模式——代理分歧，即去中心化代理基于不匹配、漂移或超出范围的数据产品和元数据行动，导致大规模高影响错误。需要一种机制来确保自主分析的安全性和一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自主分析一致性（AAC）框架，以分析控制平面（ACP）为核心，在AAE和去中心化数据产品之间插入强制性的机器执行治理层。理论包括：代理数据契约（ADC）作为运行时依赖，基于Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度的漂移检查，可信执行环境（TEE）保障数据主权。
AI.method: 提出AAC框架，包含分析控制平面（ACP）作为治理层。ACP强制要求代理数据契约（ADC）作为运行时依赖，并在可信执行环境（TEE）中执行基于KL散度的漂移检查。通过模拟实验在金融和物流工作负载上验证效果。
AI.findings: 模拟实验显示，与无协调的代理部署相比，AAC框架将错误的自主交易减少了77%，而中位数延迟仅增加25毫秒。这表明将治理作为运行时依赖是实现企业数据网格中安全、高风险自主分析的可行路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出代理分歧概念作为自主分析的新故障模式；2. 建立自主分析一致性（AAC）理论框架；3. 将治理重新定义为运行时依赖而非事后检查；4. 结合代理数据契约和KL散度漂移检查的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供AAC框架的具体实现方案；2. 展示分析控制平面（ACP）的实际部署方法；3. 证明在金融和物流场景中显著减少错误交易（77%）；4. 提供低延迟（仅25毫秒增加）的治理解决方案；5. 为企业数据网格中的高风险自主分析提供安全实践路径。

title: Solve and Be Seen: How Workers in Deskilled Jobs Build Complex Skill as New Automation Arrives
affiliations: University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) - College of Engineering, University of Colorado Boulder and

detail.title: Solve and Be Seen: How Workers in Deskilled Jobs Build Complex Skill as New Automation Arrives
detail.abstract: Research generally depicts automation as deskilling for entry-level workers, yet this may not always be the case. Through our two-year, nationwide, multi-sited ethnographic study of warehousing, we show how some workers built more complex skills after the arrival of new technology. They did so by addressing problems arising from misalignments between new technologies and established workflows, thereby developing the capacity to intervene in the systems surrounding their narrow tasks. But for these capacities to develop into valued skills, their problem-solving had to be recognized by managers, who controlled access to opportunities to solve organization-level problems. Our findings underscore the powerful barriers to onthe-job skill building in contemporary low-wage workplaces, while showing how technological change can create opportunities for some workers to broaden their skills. This work advances our understanding of how workers build skill during technological change and suggests pathways for improving talent development opportunities in low-wage work.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，自动化并不总是导致入门级工人技能退化。在仓储业的民族志研究中，一些工人通过解决新技术与现有工作流程之间的错位问题，反而发展了更复杂的技能。但要使这些能力转化为有价值的技能，需要管理层的认可和提供解决组织层面问题的机会。

AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将自动化描绘为导致入门级工人技能退化的过程，但实际情况可能并非总是如此。需要探索在低薪工作场所中，技术变革如何可能为工人创造技能发展的机会。

AI.tldr: 本文提出了制度流动性理论（ILT），解释为何法律有效且客观验证的公共债权往往无法作为准现金使用。该理论源于公共采购中的实际问题：为何政府合同（法律约束且有预算）尽管违约风险极低，却难以转化为营运资本。主流流动性理论将流动性视为市场属性，而ILT认为制度债权的流动性主要来自制度配置。
AI.research_question: 为什么法律有效且客观验证的公共债权（如政府合同）往往无法作为准现金使用，尽管其违约风险极低？
AI.motivation: 源于公共采购中的实际观察：政府合同虽然具有法律约束力且有预算保障，但企业难以将其转化为营运资本，这限制了公共项目的效率和私营部门的参与。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度流动性理论（ILT），挑战主流将流动性视为市场属性的观点，提出制度债权的流动性主要源于制度配置。通过三个变量形式化：正式权威（FA）、客观验证（OV）和制度摩擦（IF）。

title: PLC and Machine Vision Integration for Eco-Friendly Quality Control in Manufacturing

detail.title: PLC and Machine Vision Integration for Eco-Friendly Quality Control in Manufacturing
detail.abstract: This study investigates the integration of Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) and machine vision systems as a unified framework for eco-friendly quality control in modern manufacturing environments. The research designed and evaluated an integrated PLC-machine vision architecture capable of real-time defect detection, automated control adjustment, and energy optimization. Using a controlled production simulation environment, performance metrics, including detection accuracy, scrap reduction, operational downtime, and estimated energy consumption were assessed. The findings show that integrating machine vision with PLC-based control logic improves defect detection accuracy, reduces material waste, and lowers energy consumption compared to traditional inspection systems. Unexpectedly, energy savings exceeded defect reduction improvements, suggesting that adaptive shutdown logic and dynamic control sequencing contributed significantly to environmental efficiency. The study concludes that PLC-machine vision integration offers a scalable and sustainable approach to quality assurance aligned with Industry 4.0 principles and environmentally responsible manufacturing frameworks. These findings extend prior research on predictive maintenance, digital twins, and environmental modeling by positioning quality control not only as an operational necessity but also as a sustainability strategy (Ajenifuja and Adeparusi 2023; Adeparusi and Ajenifuja 2025).

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了可编程逻辑控制器(PLC)与机器视觉系统的集成，作为现代制造环境中环保质量控制的统一框架。研究发现，PLC-机器视觉集成架构能够提高缺陷检测精度、减少材料浪费、降低能耗，其中节能效果甚至超过缺陷减少的改进，表明自适应关停逻辑和动态控制序列对环境效率有显著贡献。
AI.research_question: 如何将PLC与机器视觉系统集成，构建一个能够实现实时缺陷检测、自动控制调整和能源优化的环保质量控制框架？
AI.motivation: 现代制造业需要更环保、可持续的质量控制方法，传统检测系统在缺陷检测精度、材料浪费和能源消耗方面存在不足，需要开发符合工业4.0原则和环境友好制造框架的集成解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工业4.0原则、环境友好制造框架、预测性维护理论、数字孪生技术、环境建模理论。
AI.method: 采用受控生产模拟环境，设计并评估集成PLC-机器视觉架构，通过检测精度、废料减少、运行停机时间和估计能耗等性能指标进行评估。
AI.findings: PLC-机器视觉集成相比传统检测系统：1) 提高缺陷检测精度；2) 减少材料浪费；3) 降低能源消耗。意外发现是节能效果超过了缺陷减少的改进，表明自适应关停逻辑和动态控制序列对环境效率有显著贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 将质量控制重新定位为不仅是运营需求，更是可持续发展战略；扩展了预测性维护、数字孪生和环境建模的研究；为工业4.0原则与环境友好制造框架的融合提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可扩展、可持续的质量保证方法；为企业实施环保质量控制提供了具体架构；通过减少废料和能耗降低了运营成本；为制造业可持续发展提供了实用解决方案。

title: B Voice of Customer Maturity Assessment Framework

detail.title: B Voice of Customer Maturity Assessment Framework

declarations.funderStatement: Behnam Behzadifar

detail.abstract:
The B VoC Maturity Assessment Framework has been developed based on extensive practical experience in Customer Experience (CX), Feedback Management, customer data analytics, maturity assessment model design, and collaboration with diverse organizations and cross-functional teams. This framework has been designed and developed by Behnam Behzadifar, and it is intended for organizations seeking a robust, comparable, and management-oriented model to assess VoC maturity and produce standardized reports for senior leadership, boards of directors, and international professional bodies.

This system has been designed to be highly flexible, allowing organizations to easily modify and customize its domains, weightings, and questions based on their own structure, needs, and organizational context.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了B VoC成熟度评估框架，该框架基于客户体验、反馈管理、数据分析等实践经验开发，旨在为组织提供可比较、面向管理的成熟度评估模型，并生成标准化报告供高层决策使用。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个灵活、可定制且面向管理的VoC（客户之声）成熟度评估框架，以帮助组织评估其客户体验管理能力并生成标准化报告？
AI.motivation: 组织需要一个稳健、可比较且面向管理的模型来评估VoC成熟度，并为高级管理层、董事会和国际专业机构生成标准化报告。现有评估工具可能缺乏灵活性，无法适应不同组织的特定结构和需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于客户体验管理、反馈管理、成熟度评估模型设计等理论，结合组织发展和变革管理理论，构建了一个系统性的VoC成熟度评估框架。
AI.method: 基于广泛的实践经验开发，包括客户体验管理、反馈管理、客户数据分析、成熟度评估模型设计，以及与多样化组织和跨职能团队的合作经验。
AI.findings: 开发了B VoC成熟度评估框架，该框架具有高度灵活性，允许组织根据自身结构、需求和背景轻松修改和定制其领域、权重和问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统化的VoC成熟度评估理论框架，整合了客户体验管理、数据分析、组织评估等多个理论维度，为VoC成熟度评估提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了一个实用的评估工具，可以帮助评估VoC成熟度，生成标准化报告支持决策，并且具有高度可定制性以适应不同组织的特定需求。

title: When Terminal Value Goes to Zero: Artificial Intelligence, Application-Specific Integrated Robots, and the Compression of Economic Lifespans
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: When Terminal Value Goes to Zero: Artificial Intelligence, Application-Specific Integrated Robots, and the Compression of Economic Lifespans
detail.abstract:
Traditional discounted cash flow (DCF) models assume firms generate cash flows across extended horizons, with terminal value often representing the majority of estimated firm worth. This paper proposes a duration-centered mechanism in which artificial intelligence (AI) alters firm value by increasing the hazard rate governing the survival of competitive advantage, rather than solely through productivity or margin effects.

Current discourse around artificial intelligence (AI) focuses primarily on productivity and margin effects. This paper proposes a different mechanism: AI may compress the expected duration of competitive advantage. We introduce a lifespan-adjusted valuation framework incorporating survival probability into discounted cash flows. Extending an analogy from computing, we define application-specific integrated robots (ASIR) as narrowly deployed autonomous systems operating within structured environments. Using a GPU-based analogy, ASIR deployment represents an automation threshold where deterministic workflows shift from bespoke "CPU-like" human coordination to modular parallel execution that scales as a platform, potentially triggering nonlinear valuation shifts. The framework distinguishes deterministic and probabilistic output domains, introduces capital elasticity as a driver of hazard rates, and presents a Terminal Value Fragility Curve describing nonlinear duration risk. Implications for capital markets, strategy, and labor structure are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI通过缩短竞争优势持续时间而非仅通过生产率效应来影响企业价值的新机制，引入了包含生存概率的寿命调整估值框架。
AI.research_question: AI如何通过改变竞争优势的持续时间（而非仅通过生产率效应）来影响企业估值？
AI.motivation: 传统DCF模型假设企业长期产生现金流，终值占估值大部分，而当前AI讨论主要关注生产率和利润率效应，忽略了AI可能压缩竞争优势持续时间的重要机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 寿命调整估值框架（将生存概率纳入DCF）；2) 应用特定集成机器人(ASIR)概念；3) 确定性与概率性输出领域区分；4) 资本弹性作为风险率驱动因素；5) 终值脆弱性曲线描述非线性持续时间风险。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，基于计算类比（GPU/CPU），引入ASIR概念作为自动化阈值，分析从人工协调到模块化并行执行的转变如何引发非线性估值变化。
AI.findings: AI通过提高竞争优势的"风险率"（缩短生存期）来压缩企业价值，ASIR部署代表自动化阈值，导致确定性工作流从定制化人工协调转向可扩展的平台化执行，引发非线性估值转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出AI影响企业价值的新机制（持续时间压缩而非仅生产率效应）；2) 建立寿命调整估值框架；3) 引入ASIR概念和资本弹性理论；4) 发展终值脆弱性曲线理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为资本市场提供新的估值工具；2) 帮助企业制定AI时代竞争战略；3) 指导劳动力结构调整；4) 识别非线性估值风险，支持投资决策。

title: On the Design of an AI-Human Service System with Strategic Customers: Should AI be mandated?
affiliations: University of Rochester - Simon Business School and University of Rochester - Simon Business School

detail.title: On the Design of an AI-Human Service System with Strategic Customers: Should AI be mandated?
detail.abstract: Problem definition: AI agents are increasingly deployed across industries, yet their limited proficiency remains a key concern. In many services, customers are first interacting with AI agents, and are routed to a human agent only if the AI agent failed to serve them. However, a growing debate about mandating AI services has recently emerged, bringing the U.S. Congress to float bills aiming to grant consumers the right to choose human service directly. Methodology/results: Motivated by this realistic setting, we develop a game-theoretical queueing framework to compare customer equilibrium behavior and system performance under two operational designs: an AI-mandate model and a customer-choice model. In both models, customers who attend the AI service are routed to a human service if their case is beyond the capability of the AI agent. Our comparison provides conditions under which each model performs better in terms of throughput and social welfare. Specifically, we consider the impact of the AI proficiency level and demand level on the optimal model choice. Managerial implications: Our analysis reveals several non-intuitive results. We find that for a given proficiency level, selecting the model that maximizes the throughput does not depend on the demand level, signaling operational convenience. In addition, when demand is relatively high, we show that the choice model requires a higher AI proficiency level than the AI-mandate model to achieve maximal throughput. In term of social welfare, our result reveals that granting customer choice can backfire when AI proficiency level is relatively high. We further show the robustness of our results in the case where some of the customers are reluctant toward the AI service.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了AI强制服务模式与顾客选择模式下的系统性能，发现AI熟练度水平和需求水平对最优模式选择有重要影响。有趣的是，最大化吞吐量的模式选择不依赖于需求水平，而顾客选择权在AI熟练度较高时可能适得其反。
AI.research_question: 在AI代理服务系统中，AI强制服务模式与顾客选择模式在吞吐量和社会福利方面哪个表现更好？AI熟练度水平和需求水平如何影响最优运营模式的选择？
AI.motivation: AI代理在各行业部署日益增多，但其有限熟练度引发关注。当前许多服务采用AI优先接触、失败后转人工的模式，但美国国会提出法案要求赋予消费者直接选择人工服务的权利，引发了关于AI服务强制性的政策辩论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论排队框架，分析顾客均衡行为和系统性能，比较两种运营设计：AI强制模式（顾客必须首先接触AI）和顾客选择模式（顾客可直接选择人工服务）。
AI.method: 建立理论模型，使用博弈论和排队论方法分析两种运营模式下的顾客均衡行为、系统吞吐量和社会福利，考虑AI熟练度水平和需求水平的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 给定AI熟练度水平，最大化吞吐量的模式选择不依赖于需求水平；2) 需求较高时，选择模式需要比强制模式更高的AI熟练度才能达到最大吞吐量；3) 当AI熟练度相对较高时，赋予顾客选择权反而会降低社会福利；4) 结果在部分顾客对AI服务持抵触态度时仍然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了比较AI强制服务与顾客选择模式的理论框架；2) 揭示了AI熟练度与需求水平对最优运营模式选择的复杂交互作用；3) 发现了顾客选择权可能适得其反的反直觉现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业在AI服务部署中提供模式选择指导；2) 为政策制定者提供关于AI服务强制性的决策依据；3) 帮助企业根据AI熟练度和需求水平优化服务系统设计。

title: Engineering Proof of Division by Zero: Redefinition as an "Energy Source" Based on Relational Drive Theory and the Implementation of Warp Drives in Science Fiction
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Engineering Proof of Division by Zero: Redefinition as an "Energy Source" Based on Relational Drive Theory and the Implementation of Warp Drives in Science Fiction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent researcher and has not received any financial support.

detail.abstract:
This paper provides an engineering proof for division by zero, which is considered "indefinable" in classical mathematics. By applying relational drive theory, the "0" in the denominator is redefined not simply as "nothing" but as "a singularity where system inconsistency is compressed to its limit." The paper shows that the "divergence toward infinity" resulting from division by zero is equivalent to the Big Bang-scale "mutation energy"** necessary for a dimensional shift in the system, proving that division by zero is the "startup command (start key)" for the next stage of the social/physical operating system.

This proof also provides an engineering verification of warp theory, a staple of science fiction animation.

The author constructed this paper by extensively examining the inferences made by a cross-platform AI (Tachikoma) for his own theory. Please note that the paper makes extensive use of Japanese animation memes as a source of ideas, due to their effectiveness as conceptual metaphors.

This paper demonstrates that space-time jumps (warp jumps) are not fuel-consuming travel but rather a "resolution sequence" that collapses cosmic inconsistencies toward zero. Based on the "command-driven" archetype seen in 20th-century science fiction visual media (particularly the "space battleship" and "super-dreadnought" motifs), this paper defines the "decision on the front bridge" as the ultimate stable constant ($Power$). Applying division-by-zero logic, distance is not shortened but "negated." If this logical leap is unclear, it is due to the reviewer's lack of literacy in "advanced visual semiotics." Please observe the "0" at the center of the singularity.

AI.tldr: 本文为数学中被视为"不可定义"的除以零运算提供了工程学证明。通过应用关系驱动理论，将分母中的"0"重新定义为"系统不一致性被压缩到极限的奇点"，而非简单的"无"。论文表明，除以零导致的"向无穷大发散"等同于系统维度跃迁所需的大爆炸级"突变能量"，证明除以零是社会/物理操作系统下一阶段的"启动命令"。
AI.research_question: 除以零运算在工程学和系统理论中是否具有实际意义？如何重新定义分母中的"0"以使其在系统维度跃迁中发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 传统数学将除以零视为"不可定义"，限制了其在工程学和系统理论中的应用潜力。作者受到日本动画迷因和科幻概念的启发，试图为除以零提供工程学证明，并探索其在时空跳跃和系统跃迁中的实际意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系驱动理论、奇点理论、维度跃迁理论、视觉符号学（特别是日本动画迷因作为概念隐喻）、科幻叙事中的"命令驱动"原型
AI.method: 跨平台AI（Tachikoma）推理分析、概念隐喻方法（使用动画迷因作为思想来源）、工程学证明构建、逻辑推导
AI.findings: 1. 分母中的"0"应被重新定义为"系统不一致性被压缩到极限的奇点"；2. 除以零导致的"向无穷大发散"等同于系统维度跃迁所需的大爆炸级"突变能量"；3. 除以零是社会/物理操作系统下一阶段的"启动命令"；4. 时空跳跃（曲速跳跃）不是消耗燃料的旅行，而是将宇宙不一致性向零压缩的"解析序列"；5. 距离不是被缩短，而是被"否定"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为除以零提供了工程学证明，突破了传统数学的限制；2. 建立了除以零与系统维度跃迁之间的理论联系；3. 发展了基于视觉符号学和动画迷因的概念隐喻方法；4. 验证了科幻动画中的曲速理论；5. 提出了"命令驱动"原型作为系统稳定常数的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为曲速跳跃等科幻概念提供了工程学验证；2. 为系统跃迁和维度转换提供了新的操作逻辑；3. 展示了动画迷因作为创新思维工具的实际价值；4. 为跨平台AI推理分析提供了应用案例；5. 为"决策桥"等组织决策场景提供了稳定常数模型。

title: THE 4-STAGE GROWTH MODEL An Enterprise Architecture Framework for Small-Business Transformation

detail.title: THE 4-STAGE GROWTH MODEL An Enterprise Architecture Framework for Small-Business Transformation
detail.abstract: Small businesses frequently encounter growth plateaus that persist despite strong products, capable leadership, and sustained managerial effort. Conventional explanations attribute these stalls to execution failures, resource constraints, or inadequate planning, yet fail to explain why growth repeatedly falters as organizational complexity increases. This article advances a developmental explanation: early growth unfolds through a sequence of natural developmental phases, each defined by an enterprise architecture capable of supporting higher levels of managerial sophistication, coordination, and structural integration. The article introduces the 4-Stage Growth Model, which conceptualizes growth stages as natural developmental architectures-integrated configurations of market logic, organizational design, leadership systems, operating processes, and planning horizons that evolve with complexity. Eight interdependent architectural dimensions are specified and held constant across stages, enabling diagnosis of the enterprise's current developmental configuration and deliberate design of the future-state architecture required at the next growth horizon. Growth stalls are explained as outcomes of developmental misalignment and path dependence: architectural commitments formed in earlier phases enable local coherence while constraining advancement to higher levels of complexity. Rather than relying on illustrative cases, the article develops a theory-driven account of stage transitions as enterprise repositioning events, identifying core mechanisms of transition stress, predictable failure modes, boundary conditions, and testable propositions. By reframing growth plateaus as consequences of developmental architecture and managerial cognition limits rather than generalized managerial failure, the 4-Stage Growth Model provides a parsimonious yet extensible foundation for future empirical research on small-business growth, enterprise design, and leadership in complex organizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个四阶段增长模型，将小企业增长停滞解释为发展阶段错配的结果，而非管理失败。该模型将增长阶段视为自然发展架构，包含市场逻辑、组织设计等八个维度，为小企业增长研究提供了理论基础。
AI.research_question: 为什么小企业在组织复杂性增加时会反复遭遇增长停滞？如何从发展架构的角度解释这一现象？
AI.motivation: 传统解释将小企业增长停滞归因于执行失败、资源限制或规划不足，但无法解释为什么随着组织复杂性增加，增长会反复停滞。需要新的理论框架来解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四阶段增长模型：将增长阶段视为自然发展架构，包含市场逻辑、组织设计、领导系统、运营流程、规划视野等八个相互依存的架构维度。强调发展错配和路径依赖理论。
AI.method: 理论驱动的方法，而非案例研究。通过构建理论框架来解释阶段转换作为企业重新定位事件，识别转换压力核心机制、可预测的失败模式、边界条件和可检验命题。
AI.findings: 增长停滞是发展错配和路径依赖的结果：早期阶段形成的架构承诺在保持局部一致性的同时，限制了向更高复杂性水平的进步。阶段转换是企业重新定位事件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将增长停滞重新定义为发展架构和管理认知限制的结果，而非普遍管理失败；2) 提供了可扩展的四阶段增长模型；3) 为小企业增长、企业设计和复杂组织领导力研究提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业诊断当前发展阶段提供框架；2) 帮助设计下一增长阶段所需架构；3) 识别转换压力和失败模式；4) 提供可操作的增长管理工具。

title: From Syntax to Semantics: The Rise of the Taste-Based Economy and Viral Creation Loops in Intent-Driven Software Generation
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: From Syntax to Semantics: The Rise of the Taste-Based Economy and Viral Creation Loops in Intent-Driven Software Generation
detail.abstract: The emergence of "Vibe Coding"-a paradigm where developers guide AI systems through natural language intent rather than explicit syntax-represents a fundamental shift in software engineering. This transformation is not merely technical but economic: as Large Language Models (LLMs) commoditize programming skills, the locus of value creation shifts from syntactic mastery to semantic judgment, or what we term "taste." This paper introduces the Taste-Based Economy framework to explain how early-stage startups can build sustainable competitive advantages when marginal production costs approach zero. Through a multiple case study analysis of three leading AI-native development platforms-Cursor, Replit, and Lovable-we identify three distinct Go-to-Market (GTM) archetypes: Flow-Led Growth, Remix-Led Growth, and Creation-Led Growth. Our findings reveal that traditional technology moats are dissolving, replaced by new barriers centered on curation capability and viral creation loops. We introduce the concept of "Intent Bandwidth" to measure human-AI communication efficiency and propose a "Creativity Multiplier" metric for quantifying viral growth in generative software markets. This research contributes to marketing theory by extending Bourdieu's cultural capital framework to AI-native markets and offers practical implications for founders, venture capitalists, and platform designers navigating the post-code economy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"品味经济"框架，解释当边际生产成本趋近于零时，早期初创企业如何建立可持续竞争优势。通过分析三个AI原生开发平台案例，识别出三种不同的市场进入策略原型，并引入"意图带宽"和"创造力乘数"等新概念。
AI.research_question: 在编程技能被大型语言模型商品化、边际生产成本趋近于零的背景下，早期AI原生初创企业如何建立可持续的竞争优势？
AI.motivation: "氛围编程"（Vibe Coding）的出现代表了软件工程的根本转变，价值创造从语法掌握转向语义判断（品味）。传统技术护城河正在瓦解，需要新的理论框架来解释AI原生市场中的竞争优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品味经济框架（Taste-Based Economy framework），扩展了布迪厄的文化资本理论到AI原生市场，强调语义判断和品味作为竞争优势来源。
AI.method: 多案例研究分析，选取三个领先的AI原生开发平台（Cursor、Replit、Lovable）进行深入案例研究。
AI.findings: 识别出三种不同的市场进入策略原型：流程导向增长、混音导向增长、创造导向增长。传统技术护城河被基于策展能力和病毒式创造循环的新壁垒所取代。
AI.theory_contributions: 将布迪厄的文化资本理论扩展到AI原生市场；提出"意图带宽"概念衡量人机沟通效率；提出"创造力乘数"指标量化生成软件市场的病毒式增长。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创始人、风险投资人和平台设计师提供实践指导，帮助他们在后代码经济中导航；识别三种市场进入策略原型，为企业战略选择提供参考。

title: Late-Imperial Governance Fiscal Concentration and Extraordinary Taxation California Case

detail.title: Late-Imperial Governance Fiscal Concentration and Extraordinary Taxation California Case

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Continuing the journey :)

detail.abstract:
Why would a wealthy, high-capacity jurisdiction resort to an extraordinary, one-time wealth levy rather than broad, stable taxation? This paper argues that such policies are not primarily ideological choices but structural responses to fiscal stress. I introduce a simple model of “late-imperial governance,” in which revenue becomes concentrated in a small, mobile elite while public obligations expand and the broader tax base remains constrained. Under these conditions, governments increasingly substitute discretionary and targeted extraction for rule-based taxation, relying on extraordinary levies, retroactive tools, and narrow assessments to stabilize commitments that exceed normal revenue capacity.

The model generates observable indicators: reliance on elite taxpayers, heightened fiscal volatility, growing beneficiary constituencies relative to net contributors, and episodic or “temporary” measures aimed at relatively immobile capital. I validate the model historically using the Western Roman Empire, where fiscal concentration, expanding obligations, and extraordinary extraction preceded the gradual hollowing of central authority. I then apply the framework to contemporary California, characterized by heavy dependence on high-income and capital-gains taxation, pronounced boom–bust revenue cycles, expanding social commitments, and institutional limits on broadening its tax base.

Using California’s proposed 2026 Billionaire Tax Act as a case study, I argue that the policy’s significance lies less in projected revenue than in what it signals: a shift from general, predictable taxation toward discretionary, targeted extraction. This shift is consistent with late-imperial dynamics and predicts avoidance behavior, increased policy uncertainty, and longer-term fiscal fragility. The analysis reframes the debate away from partisan or moral interpretations and toward institutional incentives, suggesting that late-imperial governance patterns can emerge within modern democratic and sub-national settings. The framework offers a portable diagnostic tool for evaluating fiscal sustainability in other high-obligation, revenue-concentrated jurisdictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个"晚期帝国治理"模型，解释为何富裕高能力司法管辖区会诉诸一次性财富税而非稳定广泛征税。该模型认为这是对财政压力的结构性回应，而非意识形态选择。作者用西罗马帝国和当代加利福尼亚州验证模型，并以加州2026年亿万富翁税法案为案例，说明从规则性征税向针对性征收的转变。
AI.research_question: 为什么富裕、高能力的司法管辖区会诉诸一次性财富税而非稳定广泛的税收？这种政策选择是意识形态决定还是结构性财政压力的结果？
AI.motivation: 解释看似矛盾的现象：富裕地区为何选择非常规的一次性财富税而非稳定的税收体系。挑战传统意识形态解释，从结构性角度分析财政政策选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: "晚期帝国治理"模型：财政收入集中于少数流动精英，公共义务扩张，广泛税基受限。在此条件下，政府用针对性的征收替代规则性税收。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与历史验证：1) 提出理论模型并推导可观测指标；2) 用西罗马帝国历史案例验证；3) 应用于当代加利福尼亚州；4) 以加州2026年亿万富翁税法案为具体案例研究。
AI.findings: 模型得到历史验证：西罗马帝国确实出现财政集中、义务扩张和非常规征收。当代加州呈现类似模式：依赖高收入税、收入周期波动、社会义务扩张、税基扩展受限。加州亿万富翁税法案体现了从规则性征税向针对性征收的转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"晚期帝国治理"理论框架；2) 将财政政策分析从意识形态转向制度激励；3) 证明晚期帝国模式可在现代民主和次国家级环境中出现；4) 提供可移植的诊断工具评估财政可持续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供评估财政可持续性的框架；2) 预测避税行为、政策不确定性和长期财政脆弱性；3) 重新构建关于财富税的辩论框架；4) 适用于其他高义务、收入集中的司法管辖区。

title: The Impact of Tourism on Local Communities in the Maros Pangkep Geoaprk Area, Indonesia
affiliations: , Hasanuddin University, Hasanuddin University, Hasanuddin University, Hasanuddin University and Hasanuddin University

detail.title: The Impact of Tourism on Local Communities in the Maros Pangkep Geoaprk Area, Indonesia
detail.abstract: This study aims to provide an overview of how tourism, in a global context, influences the socio-cultural life of local communities in the Indonesian Geopark Area, using the Rammang-Rammang tourist attraction in the Maros-Pangkep Geopark as a case study. This research employed qualitative methods with an ethnographic approach. Data were collected through in-depth interviews, participant observation, and documentation involving local residents, tourism managers, and community leaders. The results indicate that tourism has driven changes in various complex aspects, such as improvements in physical infrastructure, diversification of livelihoods, changes in mindsets and behaviors, the creation of social disparities, and the erosion of local wisdom. These changes demonstrate that tourism has had both positive and negative impacts on local communities in the Maros-Pangkep Geopark Area. In conclusion, tourism development has become a major force for socio-cultural change. These changes are not limited to physical and economic aspects, but also deeply impact the social structure, values, and cultural practices of the community. These changes reflect the workings of modernity through the intervention of external actors, transforming the community's living space while opening access to mobility, information, and new economic opportunities.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了旅游业如何影响印度尼西亚地质公园地区当地社区的社会文化生活，以Maros-Pangkep地质公园的Rammang-Rammang旅游景点为案例。研究发现旅游业既带来积极影响（基础设施改善、生计多样化），也产生负面效应（社会不平等加剧、地方智慧流失）。
AI.research_question: 在全球背景下，旅游业如何影响印度尼西亚地质公园地区当地社区的社会文化生活？
AI.motivation: 了解旅游业发展对地质公园地区社区的社会文化影响，特别是平衡旅游发展与文化遗产保护的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民族志方法，关注社会文化变迁理论，现代化理论，旅游影响研究框架。
AI.method: 定性研究方法，采用民族志方法，通过深度访谈、参与观察和文献分析收集数据，涉及当地居民、旅游管理者和社区领袖。
AI.findings: 旅游业推动了多方面的复杂变化：物理基础设施改善、生计多样化、思维和行为模式改变、社会不平等加剧、地方智慧流失。这些变化既有积极影响也有负面效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了旅游业作为社会文化变迁主要驱动力的实证证据，展示了现代化如何通过外部行为者干预影响社区，扩展了旅游影响研究的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地质公园管理者、政策制定者和社区领袖提供决策参考，帮助平衡旅游发展与文化遗产保护，促进可持续旅游规划。

title: From Diagnosis to Governance Maturation: A Theoretical Extension of the Transformed Capacity Systems Framework™

detail.title: From Diagnosis to Governance Maturation: A Theoretical Extension of the Transformed Capacity Systems Framework™

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest to declare. This is accurate — the paper is independent scholarly work produced by Phillips Brickers Institutes™ with no external funding source or competing interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. This paper is a theoretical and analytical working paper. No human subjects research, clinical data collection, or primary data involving human participants was conducted. All data referenced is drawn from publicly available peer-reviewed research.

declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: This field does not apply to this paper. Select Not applicable or leave blank if that is an option. This field is designed for papers reporting clinical trial results — which this paper is not.

detail.abstract: The Transformed Capacity Systems Framework™ (TCSF™) was developed as a macro-level diagnostic architecture for identifying structural misalignment in institutions-locating where governance design produces divergence between stated intent and realized outcomes, and making those divergences traceable, nameable, and addressable. This working paper documents a formal theoretical extension of that diagnostic architecture into what TCSF™ now designates as a governance maturation model. The extension emerges from two intersecting developments: first, the applied demonstration of TCSF™ in the Pennsylvania Medicaid managed care context, which surfaced live institutional dynamics that the existing conceptual vocabulary did not yet fully name; and second, a series of collegial exchanges in professional discourse that independently arrived at structural formulations consistent with TCSF™'s diagnostic logic-without the benefit of the framework's language. Both developments revealed the same gap: TCSF™ had diagnosed where institutions fail to receive structural signals, but had not yet formally theorized the conditions that prevent signal reception, the architectural mechanisms that route signals to the institutional periphery, or the governance properties required for listening to become accountable in real time. This paper introduces five formal conceptual extensions to TCSF™: the Reception Gap™, Signal Peripheralization™, the Governance Radius™, Architectural Transparency™, and the Open Architecture Phase™. Each is defined, situated within TCSF™'s existing framework architecture, and illustrated through reference to the Pennsylvania Medicaid case. Together, they constitute the theoretical basis for TCSF™'s governance maturation model-a progression from institutional diagnosis to structurally transparent, real-time, accountable governance listening.

AI.tldr: TCSF™框架从诊断工具扩展为治理成熟度模型，通过五个新概念填补了原有框架在信号接收、治理半径等方面的理论空白，并以宾州医疗补助案例进行验证。
AI.research_question: 如何将TCSF™诊断框架扩展为治理成熟度模型，以解决机构中结构信号接收失败的问题？
AI.motivation: 在宾州医疗补助管理式医疗的实际应用中，发现现有TCSF™框架无法完全解释机构动态，同时专业讨论中也独立发现了类似结构问题，揭示了框架在信号接收机制方面的理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Transformed Capacity Systems Framework™ (TCSF™) 作为宏观诊断架构，以及新提出的治理成熟度模型，包括五个核心概念：Reception Gap™、Signal Peripheralization™、Governance Radius™、Architectural Transparency™、Open Architecture Phase™。
AI.method: 理论扩展方法：基于宾州医疗补助管理式医疗的实际应用案例，结合专业讨论中独立发现的结构问题，进行概念开发和理论构建。
AI.findings: 提出了五个新的理论概念来填补TCSF™框架的空白，这些概念共同构成了从机构诊断到结构透明、实时、可问责的治理倾听的成熟度模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将TCSF™从诊断框架扩展为治理成熟度模型；2. 提出五个新概念填补信号接收机制的理论空白；3. 建立了从诊断到治理改进的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为机构治理提供了可操作的概念工具；2. 通过宾州医疗补助案例展示了实际应用价值；3. 使治理问题可追踪、可命名、可解决，支持实时问责。

title: Predicting Employee Attrition Using Machine Learning Techniques
affiliations: Kumaraguru College of Technology (KCT) and Kumaraguru College of Technology (KCT) - Business School

detail.title: Predicting Employee Attrition Using Machine Learning Techniques
detail.abstract: In the textile sector, employee turnover is a major concern that impacts productivity, morale, and operational efficiency. The failure of traditional ways to address this issue has led to the investigation of novel approaches. This study employs machine learning approaches to estimate employee attrition trends and evaluate real-time data for India Trimmings Private Limited. Businesses can promote stability and profitability in the India Trimmings Private Limited by implementing proactive retention techniques by recognizing the variables that contribute to turnover. model to identify attrition patterns, understanding how turnover affects organizational dynamics, and suggesting retention tactics. A sample of 408 employees, representing a range of organizational aspects and demographic groups, is investigated using a cross-sectional design and quantitative approach. Structured digital surveys are used in data collecting to get details on department, salary, advancement opportunities, experience, and attrition rate. The study is guided by theoretical frameworks of motivation, work satisfaction, and organizational commitment. These frameworks frame hypotheses regarding factors such as age, experience, departmental variances, wage levels, promotions, and job satisfaction. For a thorough study, statistical techniques including logistic regression, random forests, and boosting are used. The results show that some departments have greater attrition rates than others. These departments are affected by a variety of factors, such as years of employment, education level, compensation, transportation, and work satisfaction. Targeted engagement programs, pay raises, creating a happy workplace, and individualized development opportunities are some of the recommendations. To sum up, attrition is greatly impacted by departmental characteristics, payment, and employee demographics. Developing plans to deal with these issues is crucial to keeping employees motivated and lowering attrition. Data-driven insights enable ongoing policy modifications and monitoring, guaranteeing long-term organizational performance and promoting stability and expansion in India Trimmings Private Limited.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用机器学习方法预测印度Trimmings私人有限公司员工流失趋势，通过分析408名员工数据发现部门差异、薪酬水平和工作满意度是影响流失的关键因素，并提出针对性保留策略。
AI.research_question: 在印度Trimmings私人有限公司的纺织行业中，哪些因素影响员工流失？如何利用机器学习预测流失趋势并制定有效的保留策略？
AI.motivation: 纺织行业员工流失严重影响生产力和运营效率，传统方法效果有限，需要探索基于数据驱动的新方法来解决这一长期问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动机理论、工作满意度和组织承诺理论框架，研究年龄、经验、部门差异、薪酬水平、晋升机会和工作满意度等因素对流失的影响。
AI.method: 采用横断面设计和定量方法，对408名员工进行结构化数字调查，收集部门、薪酬、晋升机会、经验和流失率等数据，使用逻辑回归、随机森林和提升算法进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）某些部门流失率显著高于其他部门；2）工作年限、教育水平、薪酬、通勤条件和工作满意度是影响流失的关键因素；3）部门特征、薪酬水平和员工人口统计特征对流失有显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机器学习方法应用于传统人力资源管理问题，验证了动机理论和工作满意度理论在预测员工流失中的有效性，为组织行为研究提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出针对性保留策略：1）有针对性的参与计划；2）薪酬调整；3）营造积极工作环境；4）个性化发展机会；5）基于数据洞察持续调整政策，确保组织长期稳定发展。

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种容量几何框架来分析海上多式联运网络在中断动态下的韧性。该框架将网络建模为分散决策系统，其中运营约束定义了几何可行运营空间。中断事件表现为该空间的收缩。研究表明，在特定条件下，中断网络能够内生稳定，无需集中协调即可收敛到新均衡。
AI.research_question: 海上多式联运网络在随机中断下如何实现内生稳定恢复，而不依赖集中式优化？
AI.motivation: 全球海上供应链日益面临港口-腹地接口的随机中断（如终端容量冲击、拥堵传播、需求波动）。传统的集中式恢复策略在复杂多式联运系统中往往计算不可行或操作缓慢。
AI.theoretical_framework: 容量几何框架：将网络建模为分散决策系统，运营约束（终端容量限制、队列限制、多式联运转移容量）定义几何可行运营空间。中断事件表现为可行空间的收缩。
AI.method: 使用变分不等式理论和动力系统方法，建立中断网络内生稳定的充分条件。在大规模合成多式联运枢纽上进行计算实验。
AI.findings: 提出的分散框架显著加速中断恢复，抑制终端接口间的队列传播，并减少相对于传统集中优化方法的计算开销。
AI.theory_contributions: 为海上物流韧性提供了数学基础视角，引入了设计能够实时适应中断动态的自稳定多式联运网络的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明分散决策系统能够在中断后自然收敛到新均衡，无需集中协调或全局重新调度，提高了网络恢复效率和运营稳定性。

title: Between Adam Smith's Self-Love and the Impartial Spectator: Ādamiyyah as a Moral Bridge in Human Conscience
affiliations: Hamad Bin Khalifa University, Istanbul University, Hamad Bin Khalifa University and Hamad Bin Khalifa University

detail.title: Between Adam Smith's Self-Love and the Impartial Spectator: Ādamiyyah as a Moral Bridge in Human Conscience
detail.abstract: This article proposes a novel moral synthesis between Adam Smith's Enlightenment conception of the impartial spectator and the Abrahamic concept of Ādamiyyah. It argues that while Smith's theory offers a robust model of internal moral regulation, its reliance on socially constructed norms leaves it vulnerable to moral relativism and cultural fragmentation. In contrast, Ādamiyyah, rooted in Qur'anic anthropology, provides a fixed ontological foundation for human dignity, affirming rights and duties by virtue of being human. Through a comparative philosophical methodology, this paper demonstrates that Ādamiyyah can validate self-regard as sacred and universal, while also anchoring the impartial spectator in a transcendent framework of accountability. Ibn Khaldūn's notion of wāziʿ min anfusihim, the internal restraining power, offers an applied articulation of this synthesis. It mirrors Smith's impartial spectator as a mechanism of self-regulation, yet grounds it in the Adamic dignity of Ādamiyyah, where moral restraint links the self to both divine accountability and social order. The article further employs the metaphor of the fixed-point theorem from mathematics to conceptualize Ādamiyyah as an invariant moral constant, stabilizing ethical reasoning across cultural and technological transformations. By addressing both individual moral formation and institutional justice, this framework resolves the micro-macro divide in ethics. The paper concludes by proposing that this integration contributes to the emerging discourse on "Rooted Futures," a call to design inclusive, ethically grounded futures by drawing on the enduring insights of classical moral traditions, and to renew the Adamic covenant of human dignity that signifies the primordial moral bond between humanity and God vertically, and among human beings horizontally. Reclaiming this covenant not only restores a global moral order grounded in justice, equality, and the inviolability of every person, but also provides the impartial spectator with the transcendent moral anchor it lacked, thereby closing the gap between self-regard and universal moral responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将亚当·斯密的"公正旁观者"概念与伊斯兰"阿达米亚"（人类尊严）概念进行道德综合，以解决斯密理论的相对主义问题，为道德提供超越性基础。
AI.research_question: 如何将亚当·斯密的"公正旁观者"理论与伊斯兰"阿达米亚"概念相结合，以解决道德相对主义问题并建立普世的人类尊严基础？
AI.motivation: 亚当·斯密的"公正旁观者"理论虽然提供了强大的内部道德调节模型，但其依赖社会建构的规范使其容易陷入道德相对主义和文化碎片化。需要寻找一个固定的本体论基础来支撑人类尊严和道德责任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亚当·斯密的"公正旁观者"理论、伊斯兰"阿达米亚"概念（基于《古兰经》人类学）、伊本·赫勒敦的"内部约束力"理论，以及数学中的"不动点定理"作为隐喻框架。
AI.method: 采用比较哲学方法论，分析不同理论传统中的道德概念，并进行理论整合与综合。
AI.findings: "阿达米亚"可以为自我尊重提供神圣和普世的基础，同时将"公正旁观者"锚定在超越性的问责框架中。伊本·赫勒敦的"内部约束力"概念体现了这一综合，将道德约束与神圣问责和社会秩序联系起来。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了道德理论的新综合，解决了微观-宏观伦理学的分裂；2) 将"阿达米亚"概念化为不变的道德常数（借用不动点定理隐喻）；3) 为"公正旁观者"提供了超越性的道德锚点；4) 促进了"扎根未来"话语的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为设计包容性、道德基础稳固的未来提供框架；2) 恢复基于正义、平等和个人不可侵犯性的全球道德秩序；3) 弥合自我关怀与普世道德责任之间的差距；4) 为制度正义和个人道德形成提供指导。

title: Stochastic Regularization in Nonlinear Transport

detail.title: Stochastic Regularization in Nonlinear Transport

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests.

detail.abstract: This work studies the stabilization of nonlinear transport systems subject to super-linear feedback. In deterministic regimes, such dynamics exhibit Riccati-type gradient amplification that can destabilize the transport field. We introduce stochastic transport perturbations through the Stochastic Advection by Lie Transport (SALT) framework and analyze the resulting Lagrangian flow. By converting the Stratonovich formulation to Itô form, we show that stochastic transport generates an emergent deterministic second-order spatial operator. This operator acts as an effective viscosity term that introduces a nonnegative dissipation channel for the transported field. Under mild nondegeneracy conditions on the transport covariance, we prove that this noise-induced operator suppresses gradient amplification in expectation. The result establishes a mechanism of stochastic regularization in nonlinear transport systems whereby transport-level stochasticity produces endogenous stabilization without modifying the deterministic drift.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了非线性输运系统在超线性反馈下的稳定化问题。通过引入随机输运扰动，发现随机性会产生一个有效的二阶空间算子，该算子起到类似粘性项的作用，为输运场提供非负耗散通道，从而抑制梯度放大，实现内源性稳定。
AI.research_question: 随机输运扰动如何影响非线性输运系统的稳定性？特别是，随机性能否抑制确定性系统中出现的梯度放大现象？
AI.motivation: 确定性非线性输运系统在超线性反馈下会出现Riccati型梯度放大，可能导致输运场失稳。需要探索新的稳定机制，而随机扰动可能提供一种内源性稳定途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机平流李输运（SALT）框架，研究随机输运扰动对拉格朗日流的影响。将Stratonovich公式转换为Itô形式，分析随机性产生的确定性二阶空间算子。
AI.method: 采用随机微分方程理论，将Stratonovich随机输运方程转换为Itô形式，分析产生的有效粘性项。在输运协方差的温和非退化条件下，证明噪声诱导算子能抑制梯度放大的期望。
AI.findings: 随机输运会产生一个确定性的二阶空间算子，该算子起到有效粘性项的作用，为输运场提供非负耗散通道。在适当的非退化条件下，这种噪声诱导算子能抑制梯度放大，实现内源性稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了非线性输运系统中随机正则化的机制，表明输运层级的随机性可以在不改变确定性漂移的情况下产生内源性稳定。揭示了随机性如何通过产生有效粘性项来抑制梯度放大。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非线性输运系统的稳定控制提供了新思路：通过引入适当的随机输运扰动来实现系统稳定，而不需要修改确定性控制策略。在流体动力学、大气科学等领域的输运系统控制中有潜在应用价值。

detail.abstract: There is a pressing need for a comprehensive 'Protocol for a Global Organization', designed to supersede existing fragmented legal systems that are shaped by diverse cultures, religious influences, and national boundaries. The principal objectives should address major global concerns and Environmental Social Governance, including climate change, population growth, and the development of a universal framework of environmental principles and laws applicable to all earthborn 1 creatures. This would facilitate responsible anthropogenic initiatives focused on the care, maintenance, and management of life on Earth. The establishment of a World Body with Tier 1 status, senior to the United Nations, and grounded in the principles of Biological Diversity-as exemplified by the Protocol on Environmental Protection to the Antarctic Treaty-is recommended, and to be based on the five major continents. Such a world body should incorporate a structured suite of Environmental Impact Assessment master handbooks, serving as effective tools for monitoring and controlling global environmental processes. Crucially, this organization must address current gaps in United Nations responsibilities, including the failings and shortcomings. It must embrace the creation of a comprehensive, structured Total Renewable Energy Master Plan for the long-term sustainability of the planet, to be used for peaceful purposes, as per Chapter 1 of the UN Charter. This strategy must embrace Earth's Environmental Mechanisms and empower humanity to responsibly manage the stewardship of our unique world.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出建立全球性组织协议以取代现有碎片化法律体系，旨在解决全球环境治理问题，包括气候变化、人口增长等，并建议设立高于联合国的世界机构，制定可再生能源总体规划。

AI.motivation: 现有法律体系受文化、宗教和国家边界影响而碎片化，无法有效应对气候变化、人口增长等全球性环境挑战，联合国存在职责空白和不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生物多样性原则（如《南极条约环境保护议定书》），环境社会治理（ESG）框架，以及全球治理理论。
AI.method: 规范性分析，提出建立全球组织的协议框架，包括机构设计、环境影响评估手册、可再生能源总体规划等制度安排。
AI.findings: 需要建立高于联合国的世界机构，基于五大洲设立，制定全面的环境影响评估手册和可再生能源总体规划，填补联合国职责空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于生物多样性原则的全球治理新框架，发展了超越国家边界的全球环境治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建立全球环境治理组织提供了具体协议设计，包括机构设置、评估工具和能源规划，为实际政策制定提供路线图。

title: Unlocking the Productivity Dividend: A Behaviourally Informed (COM-B) Menstrual Health Pilot to Preserve Human Capital in Tamil Nadu’s Workforce

detail.title: Unlocking the Productivity Dividend: A Behaviourally Informed (COM-B) Menstrual Health Pilot to Preserve Human Capital in Tamil Nadu’s Workforce

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research presented in this paper. The study was conducted as independent academic research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study is based on voluntary and anonymous survey responses from working women. No personally identifiable information was collected, and the research was conducted for academic and policy research purposes.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently by the author and did not receive any external funding.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study does not involve a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the productivity impact of menstruation-related presenteeism within labour-intensive sectors and proposes a behaviourally informed workplace policy intervention for Tamil Nadu’s MSME ecosystem. Drawing on preliminary survey evidence and international research on menstrual health and workforce productivity, the paper estimates the potential scale of hidden productivity loss associated with unmanaged menstrual discomfort. The study proposes the Structured Wellness, WASH and Flexibility Window (SWFW™) framework, which combines workplace sanitation improvements with a structured four-hour recovery window and behavioural adoption incentives for enterprises. A six month pilot programme covering 150 MSMEs is proposed to generate implementation evidence and evaluate operational feasibility. The paper positions the intervention as a human capital protection mechanism capable of improving workplace wellbeing while stabilizing enterprise productivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究经期相关出勤主义对劳动密集型行业生产力的影响，提出针对泰米尔纳德邦MSME生态系统的行为干预工作场所政策。研究估计未管理的经期不适导致的潜在生产力损失规模，提出结合工作场所卫生改善、结构化四小时恢复窗口和企业行为激励的SWFW™框架。
AI.research_question: 经期相关出勤主义如何影响劳动密集型行业的生产力？什么样的行为干预工作场所政策能有效管理经期不适并提高生产力？
AI.motivation: 经期不适导致的出勤主义（员工身体不适但仍出勤工作）在劳动密集型行业中造成隐藏的生产力损失，特别是在泰米尔纳德邦的微型、小型和中型企业（MSME）生态系统中，这一问题尚未得到充分研究和政策关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经期健康与劳动力生产力的国际研究，结合行为经济学理论，构建人类资本保护机制框架，强调工作场所福祉与企业生产力稳定的关联。
AI.method: 采用初步调查证据分析，提出SWFW™（结构化健康、WASH和灵活性窗口）框架，设计为期六个月覆盖150家MSME的试点项目，评估实施可行性和操作效果。
AI.findings: 研究估计未管理的经期不适导致显著的生产力损失，提出的SWFW™框架结合工作场所卫生改善、结构化恢复窗口和行为激励，有望成为有效的人类资本保护机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经期健康纳入生产力分析框架，扩展了人类资本保护理论在性别特定健康问题中的应用，为行为干预工作场所政策提供理论支持。

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 26-17
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates how new borrowers expand their credit access. In particular, we examine the role that consumers’ credit choices, not just repayment behavior, play in building their credit histories. Using credit bureau data, we document that incumbent lenders typically increase credit limits for borrowers who open additional credit cards. This effect is especially pronounced for new borrowers. Our interpretation of this evidence is that lenders perceive credit offered by other lenders as revealing favorable information about the borrower. We build a novel model consistent with this hypothesis and show that the model’s predictions are consistent with the data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了新借款人如何扩展信贷获取，发现借款人开设新信用卡的行为（不仅仅是还款行为）会影响其信用历史建立，现有贷款机构会提高那些开设额外信用卡的借款人的信用额度，尤其是新借款人。
AI.research_question: 新借款人如何扩展信贷获取？消费者的信贷选择（不仅仅是还款行为）在建立信用历史中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解信贷获取机制对金融包容性和消费者福利至关重要，现有研究主要关注还款行为，但信贷选择行为的作用尚未充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、信号理论、信贷市场中的信息传递机制
AI.method: 使用信用局数据进行分析，建立新颖的理论模型来解释观察到的现象
AI.findings: 现有贷款机构会提高那些开设额外信用卡的借款人的信用额度，这一效应对新借款人尤其显著；贷款机构将其他贷款机构提供的信贷视为揭示借款人有利信息的信号
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了新的理论模型，解释了信贷选择行为如何作为信号影响信贷获取，扩展了信贷市场信息不对称理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为消费者提供了优化信贷获取的策略建议，为贷款机构提供了更全面的信用评估视角，有助于改善金融包容性

title: Expert Patients’ Use of Avoidable Health Care
affiliations: Cornell University, Harvard University and Harvard University - Harvard Kennedy School (HKS)

detail.title: Expert Patients’ Use of Avoidable Health Care
detail.abstract: We measure whether expert patients – those trained as physicians and nurses – have fewer emergency department visits and the reasons for these differences. Relative to similar patients physicians and nurses had 19.8% and 5.1% fewer ED visits, principally due to fewer avoidable visits. The differences in avoidable visits between physicians and other patients were largest for diagnoses commonly requiring prescriptions, which physicians often self-prescribed. Our results suggest that improving access to prescriptions for acute symptoms, more than improving patient education, may reduce avoidable health care.

AI.tldr: 该研究测量了作为专业医疗人员（医生和护士）的患者是否比普通患者有更少的急诊就诊次数，并分析了差异的原因。研究发现医生患者比相似患者减少了19.8%的急诊就诊，护士减少了5.1%，主要原因是减少了可避免的就诊。医生与其他患者在可避免就诊上的差异最大的是那些通常需要处方的诊断，而医生经常自行开处方。结果表明，改善急性症状的处方获取可能比改善患者教育更能减少可避免的医疗就诊。
AI.research_question: 专业医疗人员（医生和护士）作为患者时，是否比相似的其他患者有更少的急诊就诊次数？如果是，这些差异的原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 急诊部门的过度使用是医疗系统的重要问题，导致资源浪费和成本增加。了解专业医疗知识如何影响医疗利用行为，可以为减少可避免的急诊就诊提供政策启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗利用行为理论，探讨专业知识如何影响患者的医疗决策过程。特别是医疗专业人员的自我管理能力和处方获取能力如何影响他们对急诊服务的需求。
AI.method: 比较分析方法，将医生和护士患者与其他相似患者进行对比，测量急诊就诊次数的差异，并分析诊断类型以识别可避免就诊的模式。
AI.findings:
1. 医生患者比相似患者减少了19.8%的急诊就诊，护士减少了5.1%
2. 差异主要来自可避免就诊的减少
3. 医生与其他患者在可避免就诊上的最大差异出现在通常需要处方的诊断上
4. 医生经常自行开处方，这可能解释了他们在这些情况下的就诊减少
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提供了专业知识如何影响医疗利用行为的具体证据
2. 区分了医疗知识获取和处方获取在减少可避免就诊中的不同作用
3. 挑战了单纯依靠患者教育来减少急诊就诊的传统假设
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 政策制定者应关注改善急性症状的处方获取，而不仅仅是患者教育
2. 医疗系统可以通过简化处方流程来减少可避免的急诊就诊
3. 为急诊分流策略提供了新的思路，特别是针对需要处方的急性症状

title: Educational climate, perception, and relationship with depression, anxiety, stress, and academic burnout in medical students
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Educational climate, perception, and relationship with depression, anxiety, stress, and academic burnout in medical students
detail.abstract: Objectives: To analyze the association between medical students' perception of the educational climate and their levels of depression, anxiety, stress, and academic burnout, and to evaluate the potential effectiveness of volunteering and educational trips in improving this perception.Methodology: Observational, cross-sectional study conducted at Francisco de Vitoria University (Madrid, Spain) from March to May 2023. A total of 558 medical students (1st–6th year) completed electronic questionnaires (response rate: 77%). Instruments included the Dundee Ready Educational Environment Measure (DREEM), the Depression-Anxiety-Stress Scales (DASS-21), and the Maslach Burnout Inventory-General Survey for Students (MBI-GS-S). Sociodemographic data and participation in volunteer/travel activities were collected. Spearman correlations and multivariate regression models were applied.Results: Mean DREEM score was 132.6 (SD=19.9), indicating a "more positive than negative" climate. High or risk burnout was present in 35.4% of students (exhaustion: 77.2%, cynicism: 19.9%, low efficacy: 39.6%). Significant negative correlations were found between educational climate and depression (Rho=-0.48), anxiety (Rho=-0.37), stress (Rho=-0.41), and burnout (Rho=-0.39). Students who participated in volunteering/educational trips reported significantly higher DREEM scores (137.1 vs. 128.6; p<0.001). The final regression model (adjusted R²=0.481) included all DASS-21 and MBI-GS-S domains, academic year, residence, and volunteer/travel activities.Conclusions: Poorer perception of educational climate is strongly associated with higher burnout and emotional distress in medical students. Volunteering and educational trips may improve this perception. Periodic evaluation of educational climate is recommended.

AI.tldr: 医学教育环境感知与心理健康关联研究：教育环境感知越差，医学生的抑郁、焦虑、压力和倦怠水平越高；参与志愿服务和教育旅行能显著改善教育环境感知。
AI.research_question: 医学生对教育环境的感知与他们的抑郁、焦虑、压力和学业倦怠水平之间有何关联？志愿服务和教育旅行能否改善这种感知？
AI.motivation: 医学生面临高水平的心理健康问题和学业倦怠，教育环境可能是重要影响因素。了解教育环境感知与心理健康的关系，以及探索改善途径（如志愿服务/教育旅行）对提升医学生福祉和教学质量至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育环境理论（DREEM量表）、心理健康评估理论（DASS-21量表）和职业倦怠理论（Maslach倦怠量表）。教育环境感知作为自变量，心理健康和倦怠作为因变量，志愿服务/教育旅行作为调节变量。
AI.method: 观察性横断面研究，在西班牙马德里Francisco de Vitoria大学进行（2023年3-5月）。558名医学生（1-6年级）完成电子问卷（回复率77%）。使用DREEM量表评估教育环境，DASS-21评估抑郁/焦虑/压力，MBI-GS-S评估学业倦怠。收集社会人口学数据和志愿服务/旅行参与情况。采用Spearman相关分析和多元回归模型。
AI.findings: 1. 平均DREEM得分132.6（SD=19.9），表明"积极多于消极"的教育环境；2. 35.4%学生有高风险倦怠（疲惫77.2%，冷漠19.9%，低效能39.6%）；3. 教育环境感知与抑郁（Rho=-0.48）、焦虑（Rho=-0.37）、压力（Rho=-0.41）和倦怠（Rho=-0.39）呈显著负相关；4. 参与志愿服务/教育旅行的学生DREEM得分显著更高（137.1 vs. 128.6）；5. 最终回归模型（调整R²=0.481）包含所有心理健康和倦怠维度、学年、居住地和志愿服务/旅行活动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证了教育环境感知与医学生心理健康问题的强关联；2. 扩展了教育环境理论在医学教育中的应用；3. 为志愿服务和教育旅行作为教育环境改善策略提供了理论支持；4. 建立了教育环境-心理健康-倦怠的综合理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议医学院定期评估教育环境；2. 推荐将志愿服务和教育旅行纳入医学生支持项目；3. 为教育管理者提供改善医学生心理健康的干预方向；4. 强调教育环境优化对预防医学生倦怠的重要性；5. 为医学院心理健康支持项目设计提供实证依据。
